notes: Not automated: [On Play] Look at 4 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 "Firetank Pirates" or {Straw Hat Crew} type card with a cost of 2 or more and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
